content:
maria_ae: Heads-up — HealthSys wants to run a sealed-site POC. Key asks: offline installer, signed bundles/SBOM, clear rollback story, and confirmation on upgrade cadence for ISO environment. Can we scope packaging and legal handoff? cc @sam_se

sam_se: Got it. Quick clarifying q's: which OS/runtime are they using? do they require operator-based install or a tarball + systemd service? Also need to know retention for old bundles (rollback).

customer_prod_it: We're running RHEL8 (some RHEL9), container runtime is cri-o for clusters and systemd for standalone nodes. No outbound traffic from the subnet. Maintenance windows quarterly, can't do random reboots. Rollback must be possible within ~15 minutes and without internet.

devin_engops: Important constraints: no egress, KMS calls blocked. Activation must be via offline token or preloaded HSM cert. DB migrations that require schema changes must be avoidable or backwards-compatible — we prefer additive migrations only. Also storage on devices limited to 20GB spare.

julie_packaging: Packaging notes: we can produce a detached, signed bundle tarball and a minibundle variant (only runtime + small model shard) to fit smaller devices. We sign with cosign and include a cyclonedx SBOM and SPDX license list. Need to confirm signing key custody (customer or Redwood) and whether they accept cosign signatures or require their own PKI.

rachel_legal: For legal we need: full SBOM (cyclonedx), license disclosures, third-party export-control flags, and confirmation of key custody. We'll likely need a short amendment to the SOW stating that customer is responsible for local key management if they host signing keys. Also: if customer requires us to ship signed images with their key, we need to confirm indemnity and support boundaries.

sam_se: Operational approach I'm proposing: 1) deliver initial POC bundle (detached, full) on encrypted USB, with offline activation token file and signature. 2) Provide runbook and a small rollback bundle (previous version) on the USB. 3) For cadence, offer monthly delta patches (signed) or quarterly minibundle deliveries — depends on their acceptance of delta patching process.

maria_ae: Pricing note for sales: offline POC packaging + on-site handoff adds engineering hours. We should quote a fixed one-time packaging & runbook fee plus separate fees for signed-delta maintenance. @rachel_legal will need to approve language before quoting.

deploy-bot: bundle-builder: signed bundle created -> name: redwood-offline-healthsys-2026-03-12-v0.1.tar.gz, sha256: 7f3a2b9d4c5e6a8b9f3e2c1d0a9b8c7d6e5f4a3b2c1d0e9f8a7b6c5d4e3f2a1b

julie_packaging: A few technical qs: 1) Max bundle size allowed? 2) Are there any forbidden binaries? 3) Can we install a small helper for offline metrics upload (queued) or is that blocked?

customer_prod_it: Max bundle size = 8GB. No telemetry/metrics outbound at all. Everything must stay on-prem. Helper for queued metrics is OK as long as it never leaves network and can be turned off.

devin_engops: Rollback mechanics: we keep previous bundle on disk + metadata file that the offline CLI uses. Proposed CLI example: 

```
rvinstall apply --bundle /media/usb/redwood-offline-healthsys-2026-03-12-v0.1.tar.gz --token /media/usb/activation.jwt
rvinstall rollback --to-version 0.0.3 --force
```

All operations run locally, require local sudo. No external checks. Signatures checked against local trusted keyring.

julie_packaging: Good. We can do chunked bundles + model sharding to hit <8GB for the minibundle. Quantized model shards help. Need a green light on key custody (customer vs Redwood) so we can produce the signed artifacts accordingly.

rachel_legal: If Redwood holds signing keys, we need a custody SLA and rotation policy in contract. If customer holds keys, we need operational steps documented. Either way, include a clause that we won't be liable for keys the customer imports. I'll draft options.

sam_se: Next steps / action items: - Julie: packaging spec + sample SBOM (cyclonedx) by Tue EOD - Devin: offline runbook + rollback CLI sample by Wed - Rachel: NDA amendment / key custody options by Thu - Maria: include one-time packaging quote + maintenance pricing in the SOW draft

maria_ae: Thanks. I'll coordinate with the customer on a preferred key custody model (they may prefer to hold keys). I'll loop back once I hear them. :thumbsup:

customer_prod_it: We prefer to keep our keys locally. We'll follow up with an internal PKI contact.

julie_packaging: Noted — we'll prepare artifacts signed by our key for the demo and provide instructions for re-signing with customer key for production.

rachel_legal: I'll post the draft amendment in this thread when ready.

maria_ae: Great — thanks everyone. Keeping this thread as the canonical handoff for the POC.
